title: Juicy Snappy German Sausages Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful German stew featuring snappy sausages, this dish is perfect for a cold and rainy day. It is also macrobiotic-friendly and can be made with fatty and snappy sausages.

ingredients.name: German sausages
ingredients.notes: preferably with a natural casing for the snappy texture

instructions: In a large pot or Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the chopped carrots and potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the German sausages and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the sauerkraut, beef broth, apple cider vinegar, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and continue to simmer for an additional 10 minutes, or until the sausages are cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives if desired.
